in_marathi.name: Kuldip
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kuldip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kuldip is derived from the Sanskrit words 'kula' which means 'family' and 'deep' which means 'valor'. This name signifies a brave and strong individual who is deeply rooted in his family values.
